title: Active context
summary: A clean filtered list; the intro speaks engine and the chips run off the edge.

issues.what: 'Active messages returned by the server after its latest compaction. Message counts are not token counts.'
issues.fix: 'What the model sees now. Older messages were summarised to save space.'

issues.what: Filter chips run off the right edge ('User prompt ·' cut) with no fade.
issues.fix: Edge fade or a wrap to two lines; shorter labels ('System', 'You', 'Agent').

title: <message type label> (User / Assistant / System / ...)
summary: A raw message id as the heading and a disclaimer paragraph before the content.

issues.what: 'msg_assistant' is the first line under the title.
issues.fix: Remove it; the id goes under Details with copy.

issues.what: 'Snapshot of available message content. Binary attachment bodies, URLs and internal metadata are not displayed. This is not the complete provider request.'
issues.fix: One muted line at the end: 'Attachments and internal data aren't shown.'

issues.what: Part heading 'Tool output · bash'.
issues.fix: 'Ran a command'.

title: Context capsule
summary: Collected notes and errors are lost on back without a question, and the screen is named after an internal concept.

issues.what: No discard guard on back (context_capsule_screen.dart has no PopScope or confirmation), and the copy admits 'Unapplied edits are kept only while this screen is open.'
issues.fix: Confirm on back when items are unapplied ('Discard these notes?' Keep editing / Discard), as Note for the agent does, or keep them as a draft for the conversation.

issues.what: Title 'Context capsule'; 'Build a bundle'; field labels 'Label' and 'Excerpt'.
issues.fix: Title 'Add context'. 'Collect notes, errors and code, then add them to your message.' Fields 'Title' and 'Text'.

issues.what: A centred layers icon above a left-aligned title; Paste and Remove right-aligned inside the item card; four button styles (outlined chips, outlined, filled, text).
issues.fix: Left-align the header or drop the icon; item actions in a KitRowMenu; add-chips as one 'Add ▾' menu.

title: Run results
summary: A run summary that leads with what it doesn't know, cuts its own heading to a few letters, and shows raw ids and paths.

issues.principle: P8 / P-a nothing cut to a few letters
issues.what: 'Run …ssistant': the run label is cut from the front.
issues.fix: Name the run by time or number ('Run at 6:54 · 2 min').

issues.what: The state line is 'Outcome not reported · The provider gave no finish reason. Recovered from server history. This phone did not observe the newest step complete.'
issues.fix: Lead with what is known: 'Finished · 2 min · 1 file changed · tests passed'. The provenance note goes under Details.

issues.what: 'claude-sonnet-4', '/home/dev/shopfront/test/checkout_test.dart' as a row title, 'Exit code 0', 'edit, write and patch tools'.
issues.fix: Model display name; the file name as the title with its folder as supporting; 'Passed' instead of exit code 0.

issues.what: Three disclaimers: 'Not a verified diff of the working tree', 'Exit codes appear only when…', 'Nothing is summarised by a model'.
issues.fix: One Details line at the end.

issues.what: 'Open conversation' is a half-width tonal button, left-aligned, at the end of the scroll.
issues.fix: Full-width pinned primary.

title: Session context
summary: The ring and '10,332 of 200,000 tokens' are a good hero; the rest is a raw accounting table with a legend that keys nothing.

issues.what: 'Estimated input makeup' shows four near-identical green squares as a legend with no chart; the shades can't be told apart.
issues.fix: One stacked bar with four distinct tones and labelled segments, or drop the squares and keep the numbers.

issues.what: 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4' under the model name; 'Latest assistant request, including cache activity'; rows for Cache read, Cache write and Reasoning above the fold.
issues.fix: Hero: '5 % of context used'. The request table goes under a Details fold; the raw model id is dropped.

issues.what: The 'Active context · Inspect messages after compaction' row sits above the hero figure.
issues.fix: Hero first; the messages link below it as 'See what the model sees'.

title: Export conversation
summary: Clean choice and a pinned Save; the default redaction silently strips the conversation text.

issues.what: 'Redact sensitive data' is on by default and 'Replaces conversation text and sensitive fields with placeholders', so the default export has no conversation in it.
issues.fix: Default off for 'Readable transcript'; if redaction stays default, say what survives ('Keeps structure; replaces your text').

issues.what: Format choices are tinted cards; Add server uses radio rows for the same kind of choice.
issues.fix: One choice-row style.

title: Import conversation
summary: Reassuring copy and a clear order; the destination is a path, the preview shows a raw id and a plural bug.

issues.what: Preview shows '1 message records' and 'ses_transfer'.
issues.fix: '1 message' and the conversation title only.

issues.what: 'Import into' shows '/home/dev/shopfront' while the chooser sheet shows the project name 'shopfront'.
issues.fix: Project name with the path as supporting, as in the sheet.

issues.what: 'Change destination' is a centred text button among left-aligned content.
issues.fix: Make the destination a KitRow with a chevron.

title: Import into
summary: A one-option chooser with no current mark.

issues.what: The only project isn't marked as current, and with one option the sheet offers no choice.
issues.fix: Current mark on the selected row; hide 'Change destination' when there is only one project.

title: Note for the agent
summary: A good small editor with a byte counter that counts nothing, a busy-button spinner, and a delete that doesn't ask.

issues.what: The empty note shows '2 / 8192 bytes'.
issues.fix: Count what the field holds, in characters; show the counter only near the limit.

issues.what: 'Delete saved note' is an accent text button that deletes at once (session_note_screen.dart _save(remove: true), no confirmation or undo).
issues.fix: Error-coloured, with a snackbar Undo or a confirm.

issues.what: Save shows a spinner inside the disabled button while saving; when unchanged it is dimmed with no reason.
issues.fix: Progress in the kit's loading bar; 'No changes to save' near the dimmed button.

issues.what: A three-sentence intro.
issues.fix: 'A standing instruction for this conversation. The agent reads it at its next step.'

title: Discard your note changes?
summary: The right guard; 'Discard changes' isn't coloured as destructive and there's no body.

issues.what: 'Discard changes' is an accent text button beside 'Keep editing'.
issues.fix: Error-coloured 'Discard'; body 'Your edits to the note will be lost.'

title: Subagent sessions
summary: Readable parent/child structure; the title is cut, the conversation name appears twice, and the empty state is the old style.

issues.what: The title is truncated: 'Subagent conversatio…'.
issues.fix: Title 'Subagents'.

issues.what: 'Fix flaky checkout test' appears in the header and again as the parent row; the parent row is entirely accent-coloured text.
issues.fix: Drop the header row; the parent row uses normal text with a 'Working' status mark.

issues.what: '(@explore subagent)', '1 of 2'.
issues.fix: Supporting line 'Explore agent · 20 min ago'.

issues.what: Empty uses the old centred icon and says the same thing twice ('OpenCode has not delegated work…' in the header and 'No subagent conversations yet').
issues.fix: KitStateView empty once: 'No subagents yet · When the agent hands work off, it shows here.'

title: Recorded tool output
summary: A full-height sheet for a single row.

issues.what: One row ('Edit checkout_test.dart +5 · −2 ✓') with most of the sheet empty.
issues.fix: Size the sheet to its content.

issues.what: Title 'Recorded tool output'.
issues.fix: 'What it did'.

title: Copy handoff reference? | Continue on computer
summary: A second 'Continue on computer' with different words and command from the sheet, and a fallback that copies a JSON blob of ids.

issues.principle: P7 / U6 one action, one place
issues.what: This dialog and continue-on-computer-sheet both offer 'Continue on computer' with different commands ('opencode attach …' vs 'cd … && opencode --…') and different copy.
issues.fix: One sheet for the handoff; remove the dialog.

issues.what: 'Run this command in a POSIX shell…', 'Set OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD privately…', 'conversation ID'; the command wraps mid-token inside the dialog.
issues.fix: Plain: 'Run this on your computer to open this conversation there.' Command in a horizontally scrolling mono box.

issues.what: 'Copy handoff reference?' is three paragraphs and a JSON object with sessionID and projectID.
issues.fix: Remove this path; offer 'Export conversation' and 'Open on another phone' instead.

title: Continue on computer
summary: The better of the two handoffs; the command is cut off and version notes sit in the body.

issues.what: The command shows 'cd '/home/dev/shopfront' && opencode --' and is cut at the edge.
issues.fix: Wrap it in the mono box, or scroll with a fade; copy copies it all.

issues.what: 'Verified against opencode 1.18.25, opencode2 beta-19242. If your installed version differs, check opencode --help for the --session flag.'
issues.fix: Move to Details.

issues.what: A grey tinted box says 'Reload the conversation and try again' with no button.
issues.fix: KitNotice with a 'Reload' action.

title: Open on another phone
summary: Clear and useful: a large QR, what it carries, and what the other phone needs.

issues.what: 'this saved server's ID and the conversation ID'; the link line is cut mid-token ('profile=laptop&').
issues.fix: 'It only points to this conversation: no messages, address or password.' Let the link wrap in mono.

title: Files
summary: A plain, readable list, but two stacked headers, no sense of where you are in the tree, and error and empty states that double up or hide the way out.

issues.principle: U6 / P1 One thing at a time
issues.what: Two headers stack at the top: the shell header 'Laptop ▾ / Project' and below it a '← Files' bar. The subtitle says 'Project' while the person is in Files.
issues.fix: When Files is pushed inside the Project tab, show one top bar: back, title 'Files', and the folder breadcrumb under it. Keep the server switcher header only on the tab root (Project hub).

issues.what: Nothing shows which folder is open. Inside lib/ the screen would look identical to the root, apart from the rows.
issues.fix: Add a breadcrumb line under the title ('shopfront › lib › checkout'), each segment tappable to jump up; the title becomes the current folder name.

issues.what: The failure state shows two problems and two 'Try again' buttons at once: a filled banner 'File change indicators are unavailable on this server · Try again' and the page error 'Couldn't open this folder / Could not list files.' The body only repeats the title.
issues.fix: When listing fails, hide the change-marks banner. Body says the reason in words ('The server didn't answer.' / 'This folder no longer exists.'), Try again primary, raw error in a collapsed Details row (KitStateView slots).

issues.what: The empty folder says only 'Folder is empty / Pull down to refresh this folder.' The only way to act is a hidden gesture.
issues.fix: Body: 'Nothing in this folder yet. Hidden files are not shown.' Add a visible tertiary 'Refresh' (KitStateView action) alongside pull-to-refresh.

issues.what: The change-marks message is an edge-to-edge filled block with an info icon and a 'Try again' link, not a kit part. Retrying a missing capability never helps.
issues.fix: Use KitStatusLine: 'Change marks aren't available on this server', no action (or dismissible once, since dismissing changes nothing).

issues.what: Every row carries a ⋯ button whose sheet only offers Open (the same as tapping the row) and Copy path. Seven identical dots add noise to every line.
issues.fix: Drop the visible ⋯; keep a KitRowMenu on long-press with Copy path, Attach to prompt and Review changes (for changed files). Rows that open a folder end in a chevron.

issues.what: '.git' is listed first as an ordinary folder.
issues.fix: Hide dot-folders by default with a 'Show hidden files' switch in the overflow.

issues.what: The search field's magnifier has a dropdown caret with no label; its meaning (names vs contents?) is invisible.
issues.fix: Label the mode inside the field ('Names ▾') or move the choice into the overflow; plain magnifier otherwise.

title: [File row actions: <file name>]
summary: A full sheet for two actions, one of which duplicates tapping the row, headed by the same file name twice.

issues.what: The sheet header reads 'README.md' over 'README.md': the supporting line repeats the title for any root file.
issues.fix: Show the folder as supporting text only when the file is not at the root ('In lib/checkout'); otherwise no second line.

issues.principle: X9 / X8 Container fits the task
issues.what: The sheet exists for 'Open' (already what a tap does) and 'Copy path'.
issues.fix: Replace with a KitRowMenu popup: Copy path, Copy name, Attach to prompt, Review changes (when changed). No 'Open'.

title: Changes
summary: A clear summary with a good primary; only the rows need to look tappable and stop repeating the file name in the path.

issues.what: Each row shows the file name, then the full path that ends in the same name ('checkout_bloc.dart' / 'lib/checkout/checkout_bloc.dart · +6 −2'). Rows have no status mark or chevron, so they don't read as tappable.
issues.fix: Supporting line: folder only plus counts ('lib/checkout · +6 −2'); lead each row with a status mark (modified/added) and end with KitChevron.

issues.principle: U2 State not by colour alone
issues.what: +51 −4 counts are plain grey; the modified/added split is shown only by section headings.
issues.fix: Tint + in success and − in error as the diff does, keeping the sign characters so it is not colour-only.

title: <file name>
summary: Content first, which is right, but code runs off the edge by default, copy appears twice, and the action row is a strip of three equal text buttons.

issues.what: Code lines are cut at the right edge ('Bloc<CheckoutEver', '_repository.applyCou', 'status') with no wrap control visible; the census noted unwrapped is the default.
issues.fix: Soft-wrap by default on phones with a hanging indent to the code column; 'Wrap lines' toggle in the viewer's overflow; a right-edge fade when a line scrolls horizontally.

issues.what: Two copy controls (the sheet's 'Copy' and the code block's copy icon) and an unexplained ⋯ inside the code block; for README the title and subtitle both say 'README.md'.
issues.fix: The viewer is the code block: drop the inner block chrome (label, ⋯, copy). Show the folder as subtitle only when not at root.

issues.what: Copy · Save · Refresh as three accent text buttons in a row; Refresh is rare for a file you just opened.
issues.fix: Header: title, close, one icon action (Copy) and an overflow with Save to phone, Reload, Copy path, Attach to prompt.

issues.what: The Rendered/Raw toggle floats right-aligned above the content, pushing the document down.
issues.fix: Move Rendered/Raw into the overflow ('Show source') or place a compact segmented control left-aligned under the title.

title: Project
summary: A tidy menu, but it is only a menu: no row says what needs attention, the top shows an absolute path, and search appears here and again inside Files.

issues.principle: X5 / P1 purpose in a second
issues.what: Six equal rows with static descriptions. Nothing says '3 files changed' or '1 terminal running', so the hub never tells the person where to go.
issues.fix: Put live state in the supporting lines: Changes '3 files changed', Terminal '1 running', Health 'Branch main · all good'. Order by use: Changes, Files, Terminal, then the rest.

issues.what: The header row's supporting line is '/home/dev/shopfront'.
issues.fix: Show branch and state ('main · 3 changed') under the project name; the path goes to a long-press copy or the Health page's Details.

issues.what: 'Search files' row duplicates the search field at the top of Files.
issues.fix: Remove the row, or make the hub's header a search field that searches files directly.

issues.what: 'Branch, changed files, language services, and formatters' wraps to two lines; 'Open persistent project terminals' is engine language.
issues.fix: 'Checks' with 'All good' / '2 problems'; Terminal 'Shells on Laptop'.

title: Review changes
summary: The core review surface is dense and repetitive: the file name three times, two navigators, raw git headers, and wrapped code that loses its indentation; empty and error states are the old style.

issues.what: 'checkout_test.dart' appears three times (chip, file header, diff header) and '+5 −2' three times; there are two navigators ('1 ↑ ↓' beside Unified/Split and '1 hunk ↑ ↓' at the bottom).
issues.fix: One sticky file header (name, folder, +/−, ⋯). The chip strip switches files. One bottom navigator 'Change 1 of 3 ↑ ↓' that crosses files.

issues.what: Raw git headers '--- a/test/checkout_test.dart', '+++ b/test/checkout_test.dart' and '@@ -41,9 +41,12 @@ void…' sit above the code.
issues.fix: Hide the ---/+++ lines; show the hunk header as 'Lines 41–52 · void main()'; keep the raw patch header in the file's ⋯ › Details.

issues.what: Wrapped code continues at the left edge under the line-number gutter ('the total', (tester) async {'), so a continuation reads as a new line of code.
issues.fix: Hanging indent: wrapped continuation lines start at the code column, with a subtle continuation mark in the gutter.

issues.what: Empty and error use the old centred icon-and-line style, not KitStateView. The error is one sentence, 'Could not read the diff.', with no title, reason or Details; the refresh icon is dimmed with no reason.
issues.fix: KitStateView with the kit illustration: error title 'Couldn't load the changes', body with the reason, Try again primary, raw error under Details. Empty in 'This conversation': offer 'Show uncommitted changes' as the action.

issues.what: Unified/Split is a square-cornered block toggle unlike the pill segmented control above it; at 412 dp Split is not usable.
issues.fix: Hide Split under 600 dp; move the choice into the file ⋯ menu.

issues.what: Off-token motion: the file tab animates at 160 ms and scroll-to-hunk at 220 ms easeOutCubic (review_workspace.dart lines 972, 1681, 1696).
issues.fix: Use KitMotion.quick for the tab state and KitMotion.standard with KitMotion.enter for the scroll reveal.

issues.what: The 'This conversation / Uncommitted' control is centred with a centred caption, while everything else is left-aligned.
issues.fix: Left-align it and drop the caption, or turn it into the title's menu ('Changes in this conversation ▾').

title: Comment on change
summary: A simple composer, but a typed comment vanishes on a swipe, and the buttons are a right-aligned dialog cluster inside a sheet.

issues.what: The comment sheet is a plain dismissible modal sheet (review_workspace.dart _openCommentComposer, no PopScope or confirm): a comment typed and then swiped away or backed out of is lost.
issues.fix: Guard dismissal when the field is not empty ('Discard this comment?' with Keep editing / Discard), or keep the draft per file and restore it on reopen.

issues.what: 'Cancel' and 'Add to prompt' sit side by side, right-aligned.
issues.fix: Full-width primary 'Add to prompt' pinned above the keyboard; no Cancel (drag or scrim closes), or Cancel as a text button under it.

issues.what: Placeholder names the brand ('What should OpenCode inspect or change?') even on Codex or Claude servers; 'Entire file change' is awkward.
issues.fix: 'What should the agent change here?' and 'Whole file'.

title: Stage a revert from this prompt?
summary: The safety model is right (review before it's permanent) but the words are git mechanics and the quoted prompt floats unlabelled.

issues.what: 'Stage a revert from this prompt?', 'while the revert is staged', 'Clear can restore the staged files from the saved snapshot'. The title wraps to two lines.
issues.fix: Title 'Undo from this message?'. Body: 'Hides this message and everything after it. You can check the result, then keep it or put everything back.' Option: 'Also undo file changes'.

issues.what: 'Keep the greeting concise.' sits between title and body with no label, reading like an instruction to the person.
issues.fix: Show it as a quoted row: label 'Your message', the text in one muted line.

issues.what: A trailing checkbox with a two-sentence supporting line, unlike the kit's switch rows.
issues.fix: KitSwitchRow with a one-line supporting line.

title: Review staged revert
summary: The irreversible choice is the green primary, a raw message id shows under the prompt, and the page admits it doesn't know whether files changed.

issues.what: 'Make revert permanent', which cannot be undone, is the filled green primary; the reversible 'Clear staged revert' is the outlined secondary.
issues.fix: Present the two outcomes as equals with their consequences: 'Keep the undo' (error-tonal, confirmed) and 'Put everything back' (tonal). Neither green-filled.

issues.what: 'msg_assistant' is printed under the prompt text.
issues.fix: Remove it; the message id belongs in a Details fold if at all.

issues.what: 'These are the file changes reported for this stage. Staging may already have applied them.' The app sent the stage request and should know whether files were reverted.
issues.fix: State it: 'Files were put back to before this message' or 'Files were left as they are'.

issues.what: File rows use full paths as titles ('lib/checkout/checkout_bloc.dart').
issues.fix: File name as the title, folder and counts as the supporting line.

title: Make this revert permanent? / Clear this staged revert?
summary: The permanent path is correctly error-coloured; the 'clear' path hides a possible overwrite behind a green button and vague copy, and the sheet style differs from other confirmations.

issues.what: 'Clear this staged revert?' says 'Changes made to those files since staging may be replaced. Queued work may resume.' yet confirms with a green primary.
issues.fix: If edits since staging would be overwritten, say which ('2 files changed since then will be replaced') and use error-tonal. 'Queued work may resume' → 'Messages you queued will be sent.'

issues.what: These confirm sheets are left-aligned with no icon, while Stop terminal, Remove server and Remove agent are centred with a tonal icon.
issues.fix: Pick one confirmation sheet (the kit's) and use it everywhere.

issues.what: Both bodies run three sentences; the title repeats the button label.
issues.fix: Two sentences max; button 'Keep the undo' / 'Put it back'.

title: Terminal
summary: A readable list, but the empty state offers the same action twice, the error only repeats its title, and each row shows a truncated raw command.

issues.what: The empty state has a 'New terminal' button and the '+ Terminal' floating button at the same time.
issues.fix: Keep one: hide the FAB while the list is empty, or drop the state's button and let the body point to it. Preferably the state's primary only.

issues.what: Error: 'Couldn't list the terminals / Could not list terminals.' The body repeats the title; no reason or Details.
issues.fix: Body with the reason ('Laptop didn't answer.'), Try again, Details with the raw error.

issues.what: Supporting lines are the raw command in mono, cut mid-flag ('flutter build apk --release - …').
issues.fix: Supporting line: state and age ('Running · 4 min', 'Exited · code 0 · 2 h ago'); the full command lives in the terminal surface.

issues.what: A divider appears under the first row only, inset from the text; the FAB has a dark outline ring unlike the kit's buttons.
issues.fix: Consistent KitRow separators (or none); kit FAB styling without the ring.

issues.what: 'No terminal processes'.
issues.fix: 'No terminals yet' / 'Start a shell in shopfront.'

title: Rename terminal
summary: A correct short-input dialog: focused field with the current name, Save as the verb.

issues.what: The field label is 'Title' while the action is 'Rename'.
issues.fix: Label 'Name'.

title: Stop terminal? / Remove terminal?
summary: Correctly confirmed and error-coloured; the copy is passive and doesn't say what is lost.

issues.principle: C5 / X3 say exactly what will happen
issues.what: 'The running process and its child processes will be terminated.' and 'This terminal record will be removed.' Neither names the terminal nor says whether its output is lost.
issues.fix: Titles 'Stop flutter test?' / 'Remove flutter build?'. Bodies: 'Stops it and anything it started. The output stays until you remove it.' / 'Removes it and its output from this list. This can't be undone.'

issues.what: Centred icon-circle confirmation, while the staged-revert confirmations on the same area are left-aligned without an icon.
issues.fix: One kit confirmation sheet used everywhere.

title: <terminal process title>
summary: The terminal works, but the top bar carries three unexplained icons and the status line shows a PID.

issues.what: Three icon actions (copy, a person figure, refresh). The figure toggles a text mode but reads as 'accessibility settings'; refresh could mean reload or reconnect.
issues.fix: Keep Copy; overflow: 'Text mode for screen readers', 'Reconnect', Rename, Stop.

issues.what: 'Connected - PID 4821' under the title, with a hyphen for a separator.
issues.fix: Show nothing when connected; KitStatusLine only when not connected ('Reconnecting…'). PID in the overflow's Details.

issues.what: Text mode insets the output in a darker box with its own rails, mostly empty above the text, and an input field labelled 'Terminal command input'.
issues.fix: Full-bleed output, input pinned above the key bar with placeholder 'Type a command'.

title: Review
summary: A second diff renderer with its own header, gutter and wording; wrapped lines lose their indentation here too.

issues.what: Different from Review changes: centred 'Review' title with an X, different file header, '+/−' gutter style.
issues.fix: Use one diff component for both; this screen becomes the same file view, titled 'Changes · 2 files'.

issues.what: Wrapped continuation lines return to the left edge under the numbers ('total', (tester) async {').
issues.fix: Hanging indent to the code column.

issues.what: '40 unchanged lines not included in patch'.
issues.fix: '40 unchanged lines' (tappable to expand when the full file is available).

title: <file name>
summary: Shows the file, but its header is four unlabelled icons over a MIME type, and it's a different viewer from the Files one.

issues.what: The subtitle is the MIME type 'text/plain', and it is wrong for a Markdown file.
issues.fix: Subtitle: folder and size ('shopfront · 1 KB').

issues.what: Four icon buttons in the header (copy, paperclip, download, close); the paperclip's meaning (attach to prompt?) is a guess.
issues.fix: Close plus one labelled action ('Attach to prompt'); Copy and Save in the overflow.

issues.what: A second file viewer beside the Files viewer (icons here, text buttons there), plus a second copy control in the code block.
issues.fix: One FilePreview with one header pattern for every entry point.

title: [File preview body]
summary: The JSON body is readable but boxed twice and labelled with MIME and language chrome.

issues.what: A bordered code block with its own 'json' label, ⋯ and copy sits inside the preview sheet that already has copy and a title.
issues.fix: Render the body full-width without the inner frame; keep syntax colour.

issues.what: 'application/json' as the subtitle.
issues.fix: Folder and size instead.

title: Run /{command}
summary: A fine short-input dialog that doesn't say what the arguments are.

issues.what: 'Arguments (optional)' with no hint of what /test accepts.
issues.fix: Use the command's description as helper text and an example as the hint ('e.g. test/checkout_test.dart').

issues.what: Cancel and Run right-aligned side by side, like most dialogs in these areas.
issues.fix: Decide once whether dialogs follow the stacked rule; if not, record the exception in the standard.

title: Codex account
summary: The sign-in is one clear action; the message sits in a card, the words are runtime/provider/host jargon, and the usage view uses too many type sizes.

issues.what: 'Ready to sign in' / 'Signed in on the host' is a message wrapped in a bordered tinted card.
issues.fix: KitStateView inline (icon, title, body) with the primary under it.

issues.what: 'The official Codex runtime keeps your provider credentials. Account changes apply to this host…', 'Start an official device-code sign-in on this host… provider tokens'.
issues.fix: 'Sign in with your ChatGPT account. You finish in the browser; this app never sees your password.'

issues.what: Headline 'Rate limits' and 'Token usage', big numerals, bold labels and body text: five sizes. 'Plan: plus' in raw lowercase; the two stat tiles don't fill the row.
issues.fix: SectionLabel headings; 'ChatGPT Plus'; equal-width tiles; bars take the warning tone from 80 %.

issues.what: 'Last checked Sep 26, 2026 6:55 AM'.
issues.fix: 'Checked just now'.

title: On my computer
summary: The same choice as Add server, with the jargon and order that Add server just removed.

issues.what: 'One connection to the Paseo daemon drives every agent installed there. Experimental.' and 'Directly, through Codex app-server. Experimental.', ordered OpenCode, Paseo, Codex, while Add server now says 'Claude Code or Pi · Through Paseo on your computer' and orders OpenCode, Codex, Claude.
issues.fix: Reuse Add server's three rows, words and order here, or skip this screen and open Add server with the type choice.

issues.what: All three cards use the same server icon.
issues.fix: The kind icons from Add server.

issues.what: 'add the others any time from the server name at the top' points at hidden UI.
issues.fix: 'You can add the others later in Servers.'

issues.what: Cards are inset 24 dp, off the 16 dp rails.
issues.fix: KitRow on the rails.

title: Connection help
summary: A networking manual on a phone: five screens of loopback, reverse proxy, HTTPS origin and SSH tunnels, with the checker's verdict shown as a larger paragraph after the field has scrolled away.

issues.what: 'Keep the server on its host's loopback', 'reverse proxy with a trusted certificate', 'Support streaming and WebSockets', 'Add the HTTPS origin', 'Tailscale Funnel', 'ssh -N -L 127.0.0.1:4096:127.0.0.1:4096 user@host', '[::1]' as body text.

issues.what: The verdict ('Credentials do not belong in a URL…') renders in larger type than the rest, with no icon or tone, and the field it explains has scrolled off above.
issues.fix: KitNotice (warning tone) directly under the field; the field stays in view and says 'Cleared'.

issues.what: A primary 'Explain address' at the top, then a long guide; it's unclear whether the screen is a checker or a manual.
